mapper.sql: select w.workspace_id, w.workspace_name, w.workspace_status, w.version, w.created_by_ruoyi_user_id, w.created_at as workspace_created_at, w.updated_at as workspace_updated_at, m.ruoyi_user_id as member_user_id, m.workspace_role, m.member_status, m.created_at as membership_created_at from aden_workspace_member m join aden_workspace w on w.workspace_id = m.workspace_id where m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' and w.workspace_status = 'ACTIVE'
